# ssp_site (Data Source)

Reads a specific site from the SSP platform by its ID.

Corresponds to `GET /ssp/sites/{site-id}`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the site to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_status` (String) Site cluster status: `STABLE`, `DEGRADED`, or `UNAVAILABLE`.
- `connection_status` (String) Connection health: `HEALTHY`, `UNHEALTHY`, or `UNKNOWN`.
- `current_state` (String) Current readiness: `READY`, `NOT_READY`, `INACTIVE`, or `UNKNOWN`.
- `nsx_cluster_id` (String) NSX cluster ID (NSX_MANAGER sites only).
- `nsx_version` (String) NSX software version (NSX_MANAGER sites only).
- `site_name` (String) Display name of the site.
- `site_type` (String) Site type: `NSX_MANAGER`, `AVI`, or `SSP`.
